subject: business_studies

concepts.title: Scope of e-Business
concepts.definition: The range of electronic business activities, categorized by the parties involved in the transactions.
concepts.key_idea: e-Business encompasses interactions between businesses, customers, and internal organizational departments.
question_patterns: what are the major constituents of e-business
define the scope of e-business
how are electronic transactions classified
explain the different directions of e-business

solution_steps.action: Identify the four primary transaction types
solution_steps.explain: The scope is defined by the interaction between Business-to-Business (B2B), Business-to-Consumer (B2C), Intra-Business (Intra-B), and Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C).

concepts.title: Benefits of e-Business
concepts.definition: Operational advantages gained by firms and consumers through the use of electronic networks.
concepts.key_idea: e-Business lowers costs, increases speed, and removes geographical barriers.
question_patterns: list the benefits of e-commerce to business organizations
how does e-business facilitate global reach
why is e-business considered more efficient
what are the advantages of e-business for consumers

solution_steps.explain: Benefits are divided into organizational gains (cost, reach, speed) and consumer benefits (flexibility, convenience, choice).

concepts.title: Limitations of e-Business
concepts.definition: Inherent challenges and risks associated with conducting business activities in a digital environment.
concepts.key_idea: Digital business faces hurdles like lack of personal touch, security risks, and technological dependency.
question_patterns: what are the limitations of e-business
why is e-business considered risky
explain the problem of low personal touch in e-business
how does anonymity affect online transactions

solution_steps.explain: Major limitations include low personal touch, order fulfillment speed incongruence, security risks, and ethical concerns.

concepts.title: Online Transaction Process
concepts.definition: The sequential stages involved in executing a commercial transaction over the internet.
concepts.key_idea: Online trading involves registration, order placement, payment, and delivery.
question_patterns: describe the steps in online trading
what is the process of online buying
how does a customer complete an online transaction
what are the stages of online business

solution_steps.explain: The process flows from information seeking to payment and final fulfillment.

concepts.title: Security Risks in e-Business
concepts.definition: Potential threats to financial, reputational, or data integrity during electronic exchanges.
concepts.key_idea: Security is the most critical concern, involving risks like hacking, virus attacks, and identity theft.
question_patterns: what are the security concerns in e-business
explain transaction risks in e-commerce
how can data storage risks be mitigated
what is the role of cryptography in e-business

solution_steps.explain: Threats are categorized into transaction-based (default), data-based (virus/hacking), and privacy-based (intellectual property).

worked_examples.question_pattern: List the {stage_count} stages of online transaction.

solution_template.explain: The stages are pre-purchase, purchase, and delivery.
